name: Varanasi Cantt station
bestOption: Cab or app taxi from the station's pre-paid stand
steps: Take a cab or auto from outside the main exit.
Head towards the Ring Road / Rajatalab side.
Follow signs for Ganjari as you get close.

name: Godowlia / Dashashwamedh (the ghats)
bestOption: Walk or e-rickshaw to the main road, then a cab
steps: Cars can't get into the lanes near the ghats — walk or take an e-rickshaw out to the main road first.
Take a cab from there towards Rajatalab.
Allow extra time to get out of the old city traffic.

name: Assi Ghat
steps: Take a cab towards Rajatalab via the Ring Road.

name: BHU / Lanka
bestOption: Cab or shared auto towards Rajatalab
steps: Head west towards the Ring Road and Rajatalab.

name: Varanasi airport (Babatpur)
bestOption: Pre-paid or app taxi from the airport
steps: Book a cab at the arrivals area.
Ask for the Ring Road route to Rajatalab / Ganjari.
